description: This file defines the CognitoIdentityProvider class, which manages interactions with AWS Cognito Identity service, including obtaining credentials and managing login tokens.

classes.name: CognitoIdentityProvider
classes.description: Provides methods to interact with AWS Cognito Identity, including retrieving identity IDs and credentials, and updating login tokens.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider with pool ID, client options, logins, and optional account ID. Sets up the CognitoIdentityClient.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Asynchronous call that retrieves the identity ID and credentials from AWS Cognito and returns a Credentials object.

methods.name: updateLogin
methods.description: Updates the logins array with a new key-value pair and returns the object for chaining.
